messages:
maya: Heads-up — seeing intermittent NCCL P2P detection failures on the mixed h100/a100 pool in us-west-2 for the last ~2h. Jobs will start with NVLink but then drop to NET, some runs end with a segfault. Example log snippet below.

samir: Can you paste the exact NCCL warning? Also did we roll drivers or kernels recently on that pool?

maya: Sure — grabbed from training-job-17 on node-342: 
```
NCCL WARN P2P: cudaDeviceGetP2pAttribute returned 999 (NotSupported) for peer 1 -> falling back to NET
NCCL INFO Transport: NET (socket) used between rank 0 and 1
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'thrust::system_error'
  what():  resource not available
Aborted (core dumped)
```
We did a rolling driver bump last night (drivers/535.86 -> 536.x on some hosts) and kernel 6.1.x on new nodes vs 5.15 on old ones.

eli: That's the classic mixed-sku p2p detection gap. NVLink visibility depends on both kernel and driver + p2p query semantics. Any pattern on which nodes fail? new nodes or old ones?

maya: Fails primarily when a job spans an H100 (new hosts) and an A100 (older hosts). If the job is scheduled entirely on same-sku machines it's fine. Also saw that on node-342 `nvidia-smi topo -m` shows NVLink between local GPUs but the peermap reported to NCCL is incomplete.

samir: Can you run these quick checks on a failing combo?
ssh node-342 'nvidia-smi topo -m'
ssh node-342 'cat /proc/driver/nvidia/gpus/0000:3b:00.0/information'
ssh node-342 'dmesg | grep -i p2p | tail -n 50'

maya: Ran them, trimming outputs: 
```
# nvidia-smi topo -m (node-342)
GPU0 GPU1 GPU2 GPU3 CPU
GPU0  X   NV1  PHB  PHB  0
GPU1 NV1  X   PHB  PHB  0
GPU2 PHB PHB  X   NV1  1
GPU3 PHB PHB NV1  X   1

# dmesg snippet
[ 1234.567] nvidia: p2p: discovered NVLink between 0000:3b:00.0 and 0000:5d:00.0
[ 1234.578] nvidia: p2p: mmap failed: -12
[ 1245.000] nvidia: p2p: peerlink status inconsistent, falling back to net
```

eli: That mmap failed (-12 = ENOMEM?) during p2p setup is alarming. Could be driver kernel interface mismatch or seccomp/pprof cgroup limiting mmap.

infra-oncall: FYI deploy bot: driver-rollout/536.2 completed for pool-2 @ 2026-03-14T03:42Z (started 2026-03-13T22:30Z). Reverted on 3 hosts due to dmesg oops.

maya: Right — host-7/host-9 reverted. But some hosts are still on 536.2 and others on 535.86. Mixed versions in the same job is possible because autoscaler mixed pools for capacity.

samir: Proposed plan: 1) add a scheduling constraint to avoid cross-sku spanning (quick mitigation), 2) pin driver/kernel combinations for canary nodes, 3) collect full core + NCCL debug logs and open NVIDIA ticket if repro. Also test with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 to confirm behavior (should force NET and avoid segfault but slower).

maya: Did the NCCL_P2P_DISABLE test: jobs continue (no segfault) but 2-3x slower as expected. So segfault tied to P2P path.

eli: Can you run the nccl-tests repro on two nodes: 
```
./build/all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 512M -f 2 -g 4  --verbose
```
and set NCCL_DEBUG=INFO,NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0 and capture output. We'll need full stack for NVIDIA.

maya: Kicking off test now. Also correlating with kernel versions — older nodes 5.15.78, newer are 6.1.32. Suspect the mmap/vma ABI change in 6.x + driver coupling.

samir: For short term: add a scheduler rule (capacity-safety) to avoid mixing H100 and A100 for jobs that request >1 node. I'll make the scheduler change and roll a canary pool pinned to 535.86 + 5.15 kernel for a set of nodes.

infra-oncall: Done: label cluster:pool-2:safe-p2p-535 pinned -> added to autoscaler blacklist for cross-sku.

maya: Thanks. I'll attach full logs & core dumps once tests finish and file ticket with NVIDIA (include driver build ID, kernel release, dmesg, topo output, and nccl-tests output).

sre-bot: Reminder: please include workload ID and node list in escalation. Also if you want priority, use support level: enterprise-critical.

samir: Follow-up owners: maya (diag + logs), eli (repro + triage), samir (scheduler mitigation + rollout). We'll sync later after nccl-tests run completes. :thumbsup:
